explanation: I grepped Mathlib for `smul_subset_self`, `smul_set_subset*` and set-level statements about `SMulMemClass`. The only other `smul_subset_self` is `Multiset.smul_subset_self`, which is about multisets and unrelated. The closest lemma is `Set.smul_set_subset_iff` (`a • s ⊆ t ↔ ∀ b ∈ s, a • b ∈ t`). It only unfolds the pointwise image subset. The content of the result is `SMulMemClass.smul_mem`, which gives membership of `r • x` in `s` and not the set inclusion. Going from one to the other already needs the proof's own membership argument, so no single declaration states the inclusion. I found no Mathlib statement of `r • (s : Set M) ⊆ s` for a `SetLike` with `SMulMemClass`.
